channels.summary: FL Studio channel rack control module.

channelCount.summary: Return the total count of generator and sampler channels.

getChannelColor.summary: Retrieve display color code for channel.

getChannelPan.summary: Retrieve stereo pan value for channel.

getChannelPitch.summary: Retrieve pitch offset value for channel.

getTargetFxTrack.summary: Retrieve target mixer insert track routed for channel.

incEventValue.summary: Increment or decrement channel event automation parameter.

isChannelMuted.summary: Query whether channel audio generation is muted.

isChannelSolo.summary: Query whether channel is soloed in channel rack.

muteChannel.summary: Toggle or set mute state for channel.

selectChannel.summary: Select or focus channel in channel rack.

selectedChannel.summary: Retrieve index of currently selected channel.

setChannelPan.summary: Set stereo pan position for channel.

setChannelPitch.summary: Set pitch tune offset for channel.

setTargetFxTrack.summary: Assign target mixer insert track for channel.

soloChannel.summary: Toggle or set solo state for channel.

device.summary: FL Studio MIDI controller device interface module.

baseTrackSelect.summary: Offset active track bank on hardware controller.

dispatch.summary: Dispatch internal hardware controller event message.

forwardMIDICC.summary: Forward raw MIDI Continuous Controller message to host.

getName.summary: Retrieve configured controller script device name.

getPortNumber.summary: Retrieve MIDI port index assigned to controller script.

isAssigned.summary: Query whether controller script is linked to a valid port.

midiOutMsg.summary: Send short 3-byte MIDI message to hardware output port.

midiOutSysex.summary: Send raw SysEx byte sequence to hardware output port.

processMIDICC.summary: Process incoming MIDI CC through active mapping table.

general.summary: FL Studio general system and undo module.

getVersion.summary: Retrieve the host FL Studio API version integer.

redo.summary: Redo the last undone edit in history.

restore.summary: Restore project to last clean save state.

saveUndo.summary: Push a labeled transaction checkpoint into undo history.

undo.summary: Undo the last edit action in history.

undoUp.summary: Step upward through undo history stack.

mixer.summary: FL Studio audio mixer control module.

armTrack.summary: Toggle or set recording arm status for mixer track.

enableTrack.summary: Enable or disable audio processing for mixer track.

enableTrackSlots.summary: Enable or disable effect slots on mixer track.

getSongStepPos.summary: Retrieve current step position along the mixer timeline.

getTrackColor.summary: Retrieve RGB color code for mixer track.

getTrackName.summary: Retrieve display name for mixer track.

getTrackNumber.summary: Retrieve numeric index for mixer track.

getTrackPan.summary: Retrieve stereo panorama position for mixer track.

getTrackSlotsEnabled.summary: Query whether effect slots are enabled on mixer track.

getTrackVolume.summary: Retrieve volume level for mixer track.

isTrackArmed.summary: Query whether mixer track is armed for disk recording.

isTrackEnabled.summary: Query whether mixer track is active and processing audio.

isTrackMuted.summary: Query whether mixer track output is muted.

isTrackSolo.summary: Query whether mixer track is soloed.

linkTrackToChannel.summary: Route active channel directly to selected mixer track.

muteTrack.summary: Toggle or set mute state for mixer track.

setTrackColor.summary: Assign display color for mixer track.

setTrackName.summary: Assign descriptive label for mixer track.

setTrackNumber.summary: Assign track index routing for mixer track.

setTrackPan.summary: Set stereo pan position for mixer track.

setTrackVolume.summary: Set output volume level for mixer track.

soloTrack.summary: Toggle or set solo state for mixer track.

trackCount.summary: Return the total number of available mixer tracks.

ensureValidPattern.summary: Ensure pattern exists and is initialized.

getPatternColor.summary: Retrieve RGB color code for pattern.

getPatternLength.summary: Retrieve total length in steps for pattern.

isPatternSelected.summary: Query whether pattern is selected in picker.

jumpToPattern.summary: Set active pattern and navigate to it in picker.

patternCount.summary: Return the total count of active patterns.

selectPattern.summary: Select pattern in playlist and picker.

setPatternLength.summary: Set total length in steps for pattern.

plugins.summary: FL Studio generator and effect plugin module.

getColor.summary: Retrieve color code for plugin instance.

getColorName.summary: Retrieve color name string for plugin instance.

getName.summary: Retrieve display name of loaded plugin.

getParamCount.summary: Retrieve total count of automatable parameters in plugin.

getParamValue.summary: Retrieve normalized value (0.0-1.0) of automatable parameter.

getPluginName.summary: Retrieve generator or effect type identifier.

getPresetCount.summary: Retrieve total count of factory and user presets.

getPresetName.summary: Retrieve preset title for given preset index.

isValid.summary: Query whether plugin slot contains a valid, loaded plugin.

setParamValue.summary: Assign normalized automation value for plugin parameter.

showEditor.summary: Toggle display of graphical user interface editor for plugin.

continuousMove.summary: Move the song playback position continuously.

getSongLength.summary: Retrieve total song length in beats or seconds.

globalTransport.summary: Dispatch a global transport action code.

isPlaying.summary: Query whether transport playback is active.

isRecording.summary: Query whether transport recording mode is active.

markerJump.summary: Jump playback to the previous or next timeline marker.

setSongPos.summary: Set the normalized playback cursor position.

ui.summary: FL Studio user interface control module.

getFocused.summary: Query whether specified FL Studio window currently holds focus.

getStepEditMode.summary: Retrieve channel rack step sequencer edit mode.

getVisible.summary: Query whether specified FL Studio window is currently visible.

getVisibleForm.summary: Query whether floating tool form is currently visible.

hideWindow.summary: Hide the designated FL Studio workspace window.

scrollWindow.summary: Scroll contents of specified window by delta.

setFocused.summary: Direct focus to the specified workspace window.

setStepEditMode.summary: Configure channel rack step editing mode.

showWindow.summary: Display and bring forward the designated workspace window.

snapMode.summary: Retrieve current timeline snap grid setting.

snapWindow.summary: Snap window position to preset desktop docking grid.

OnDeInit.summary: Invoked when script is unloaded or MIDI device disconnected.

OnDirtyChannel.summary: Invoked when channel properties or parameters mutate.

OnDirtyMixerTrack.summary: Invoked when mixer track properties or volume mutate.

OnIdle.summary: Invoked periodically by FL Studio main thread idle loop.

OnInit.summary: Invoked when script is initialized and linked to MIDI port.

OnMidiIn.summary: Invoked on incoming standard MIDI channel message.

OnMidiMsg.summary: Invoked on low-level MIDI status message.

OnMidiOutMsg.summary: Invoked when script emits outgoing MIDI message.

OnProjectLoad.summary: Invoked when project file loading begins or finishes.

OnRefresh.summary: Invoked when host UI or mixer state is refreshed.

OnSendTempMsg.summary: Invoked to post temporary notification to FL Studio hint bar.

OnSysEx.summary: Invoked on incoming MIDI System Exclusive message.

OnUpdateBeatIndicator.summary: Invoked on musical metronome beat pulse.

OnWaitingForInput.summary: Invoked when FL Studio enters modal waiting dialog.
